tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// seng ge sgra'i sgo nas gdon sgrol gyi cho ga rin chen phreng mdzes zhes bya ba nag po 'gro shes su bkod pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bud+dha siṃ hā ya/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i thugs rje'i rlan las nye bar bskrun gang nyes pas ma gos pad+ma'i rigs kyi mchog /mchog gsum ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ge sar thabs mkhas thugs rje'i 'dab stong 'od zer rab tu 'phros// 'phros pas phrin las dri bsung phyogs bcur khyab pas gdul bya bung ba'i tshogs rnams tshims mdzad 'jig rten mgon// mgon gyi rje btsun seng ge sgra zhes chu skyes mchog gi zhabs pad btud de de yi cho ga bri// sngon du bsnyen pa dang ni las sbyor sbyor dngos rjes gsum dang po dkyil 'khor rten bum mchod gtor lnga// dngos gzhi bdag lha klu gdon bsgrub bya lnga rjes mchod bzod gshegs bsrung bsngo lnga gsum lnga bco lnga'o// dang po dkyil 'khor lha klu sa bdag gsum dang rten mchod gso gnyis bum lha klu rtsi sman gsum mchod// thun mong thun mong min dang lha klu cha gsum la sogs bdag bskyed bzlas pa mchod bstod bum bzlas dang*// lha bskyed byin rlabs dgug gzhug dbang dang mchod bstod gtor ma btang dang klu bskyed spyan drangs dgug gzhug dbang*// mchod bstod gdon la dgug gzhug mchod dang gso ba dbang bskur dam bzhag bsgrub bya bkru byabs bsrung ba'o// rjes la mchod bstod nongs pa bzod gsol gshegs gsol bsrung dang yongs su bsngo ba dang bcas mdor bstan dang*// rgyas bshad sdom rnams 'gro ba'i don du gdon sgrol cho ga rin chen phreng mdzes zhes bya bri bar bya// 'dir slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mīs mdzad pa'i rje btsun seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs dang*/ gdon sgrol gyi cho ga bla ma mal lo tsā ba nas rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la phyag len gyi rim pa bka' babs pa'i rje btsun seng ge sgra'i rnal 'byor la brten nas/

rang dang gzhan gyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu bsgrub pa la gnyis te/ bsnyen pa dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po la bum pa la brten pa dang*/ ma brten pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo sogs mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha ltar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi rnal 'byor la brten nas/ tha ma grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum phrag brgyad cu/ 'bring dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug rab mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa dngos sam rmi lam du sku mthong ba sogs rtags ma byung gi bar dang*/ shin tu tha mas kyang de rnams ma grub na/ med kha med kyi yan lag 'di'i rjes gnang dang lung thob pa/ snying po la 'bru 'bum zla ba gcig la 'gro bas/ gtsang sbra dang bcas pas bya ba sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum mo// dang po la lnga/ dkyil 'khor/ rten/ bum pa/ mchod pa/ gtor ma bsham pa'o// dang po dkyil 'khor gang du bzhengs pa'i phyogs gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba dang*/ klu theb yod cing*/ gza' skar bzang po 'dzom pa'i nyin/ sa stegs khod snyoms la ba'i lci ba gtsang ma dri zhim po'i chus legs par byugs la/ slob dpon zhal nub tu phyogs pa'i mdun du byang nas rim pa ltar/ dang po lha'i dkyil 'khor khru gang pa pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar seng ge sgra'i tshon phung dkar po/ rigs lnga'i mtshan ma steng du dkar po/

gtso bo'i mdun rgyab gang rung du bya/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang gu rnams tshon phung ngam/ me tog gi tshom bu sogs gang rung dgod do// gnyis pa de'i g.yas phyogs su klu'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bral ba/ mun pa ka ba ka rgyan kyang mi dgos/ rtsig pa/ 'dod snam/ pha gu/ drwa ba/ mda' yab/ pu shu/ rtsig nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du lcags ri cha phran gcig bskor ba'i nang du mtsho dang*/ de la phyogs rer sbrul gnyis brang sprod/ mtshams bzhir mjug ma mdud pa/ tshon mdog ni pad+ma dkar po'am sna tshogs/ phyogs mdog shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ rtsig pa nang nas dmar sngo dkar ba/ 'dod snam dmar/ pha gu ser/ drwa ba'i gzhi nag drwa ba dkar/ mda' yab sngo/ pu shu dkar po/ chu sngo skya/ sbrul phyogs mdog lcags ri sngon po bya'o// pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma la klu so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i tshon phung ngam/ nam̐ dgu dgod do// bsdu na klu'i dkyil 'khor 'di la'ang pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyis btub par bshad/ gsum pa de'i g.yas phyogs su sa bdag gi dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab brgyad khru gang pa dkar po bri'o// gnyis pa rten la gnyis las/ dang po mchod pa'i rten ni zhib zan nam bag zan la klu'i gzugs stod mi la sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun pa/ snying gar thal mo sbyar ba/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa dgu byas te/ dbus kyi de che ba/ snod zangs gzhong gtsang ma la sogs pa'i nang du/ zan las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi gzugs byas pa'i gdan gyi steng du bzhag pa/ klu'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zangs kyi mañji la sogs pa'i steng du bzhag go /mañji med na dkar gong gsum gyis chog gnyis pa gso ba'i rten ni/ snod kyi nang du sa bdag chen po zhes bya ba zan las rtsa ba gru bzhi la dbus dang phyogs bzhir glad kyi mgo lnga yod par byas la/

de'i mtha' skor du klu phal pa rigs bzhi'i rten ni/ shar du sbrul/ lhor rus sbal/ nub tu ljang mo/ byang du nya/ sa bdag phal pa rigs bzhi'i rten ni/ shar du sdig pa/ lhor sdom/ nub tu kha brgyad/ byang du grog mo/ gzhan yang bya khyung*/ rma bya/ gla ba/ phag ma gtogs pa'i sems can sna tshogs kyi gzugs brnyan/ phyogs re rer gnyis gnyis bya ba'am/ de tsam ma grub na re re byas te bkod/ de thams cad kyi tha ma sbrul brgyad kyi rwa bas bskor ba/ sa bdag gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mañji sogs kyi steng du bzhag go /gsum pa bum pa la gsum/ lha dang*/ dbang dang*/ rtsi sman gyi bum pa zangs sam rdza las byas pa/ ras dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pas mgul chings prog lnga pa'am gsum pa byas te bgegs bsal/ dang po gnyis su sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga/ rin chen lnga ste bum sman nyer lnga gzhug go /gsum pa rtsi sman gyi bum par gzhi spang spos gtsang ma la byas la/ bzang drug ka ra mngar gsum dang*// 'bras bu gsum dang rgya mtsho lbu// kaṇ+ḍa ka ri chu srin sder// dbang lag pad+ma nā ga ge /gnyi ba'i me tog ut+pal sngo/ gra ma'i me tog zer bsnang*/ /mtshal dkar pu shel snying zho sha /mkhal ma zho sha zho sha'i rigs// rma bya'i mdongs dang phyag tshang ku// nor bu myu gu le brgan dmar// lhang ma lhang tsher mkhal sran te// gser gyi me tog pri yaṅku// spang rgyan dkar sngo shu dag dkar// sle tres gro ma mon bu dang*// rgun 'brum nā ga puṣ+pe rnams/ dung dang til dkar/ rdo rgyus rnams kyang sbyar/ /sbyar la gla rtsi tsha ba gsum// drag po'i rdzas rnams spang bar bya// ra dkar 'o ma'am ba ser skya'i// 'o ma dri bzang chu yis ni// sum gnyis dgang la ku shas brgyan// bum gdan steng du bzhag pa'o// bzhi pa mchod pa la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor so so'i mthar/

dbang ldan du mtshams 'dzin me tog dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod tshan pa gsum bsham/ de tsam ma grub na spyi mthun du tshar gcig phyogs mtshams brgyad du bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ dar ram ras dmar po las byas pa'i gdugs dang*/ shog bu dmar po'ang rung*/ ba dan dang*/ ras skud dmar po khru gang dang bcas pa/ klu chen dgu/ sa bdag phal pa rigs bzhi dang klu phal pa rigs bzhi ste brgyad/ sha gnyer ba gnyis te tshan pa bcu dgu bsham/ de tsam ma 'byor na klu dgu la re re/ klu dang sa bdag phal pa gnyis la re re/ sha gnyer ba rnams la re re ste tshan pa bcu gsum so so'i thad dkar bsham mo// zan la 'dzugs gzugs la btsugs na klu dang sa bdag sogs bsnad par 'gyur bas 'dzugs mi nyan no// lnga pa gtor ma ni/ lha'i gtor ma/ klu'i gtor ma/ sa bdag gi gtor ma rnams dkyil 'khor so so'i shar du bsham/ dkyil 'khor rnams kyi g.yas phyogs su/ lho nub nas shar lho'i bar/ phyogs skyong dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ bgegs gtor rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bshams la/ de rnams la mngar gsum dang khur ba sogs kyang bzhag cing*/ gla rtsi skyur dmar sogs dang ma 'dres pa'i gtsang sbra dang*/ mchod gtor gyi snod thams cad ra gan dang*/ mkhar ba dang lcags dang bse las byas pa spang ngo*// gzan yang slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs kyi steng du rdo rje dril bu/ lha dbang rtsi sman gyi bum pa/ gzungs rdor/ dung chos/ me tog gos zung*/ rma bya'i sgro lnga dang*/ gzhan yang bsgrub bya la dgos pa'i yo byad sogs sta gon bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga ste/ bdag bskyed/ lha klu gdon/ bsgrub bya la ji ltar bya ba'o// dang po bdag bskyed la gnyis las/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ bum pa bsgrub pa gnyis kyi/ dang po bdag lhar bskyed pa/ bzlas pa bya ba/ mchod bstod sogs bya ba/ gshegs su gsol ba dang bzhi las/

dang po bdag lhar bskyed pa ni rang nyid khrus byas/ gos gsar pa gyon/ stan bde ba la 'dug cing zhal dkyil 'khor la mngon par phyogs te/ thog mar oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyi sbyang*/ bsang sbyang zhes pa'i skabs su 'di ltar dran par bya/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dngas shing thog pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur ces dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas shab+da swā hā'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs lan gsum dang*/ rol mo byas te byin dbab cing 'og tu mchod pa byin rlabs dgos pa rnams la dharmā ra ṇi mi brjod pa khyad par ro// bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes bdun nam nyer gcig sogs ci nus dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun seng ge sgra bsgom par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po las 'od zer 'phros pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas/ lus shel gong dag pa lta bur gyur/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas na bla ma dang rje btsun seng ge sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes phyag rgyas spyan drangs/

na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo bhaṭ+ṭā ra ka siṃ ha nā da sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥzhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siṃ ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ puṣ+pe nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs nas/ 'grub par shog ces lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs nas haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du aḥlas seng ge dkar po/ mgo bo g.yas su bstan zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa/ ral pa dmar po thur la 'phyang zhing rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bcom zhing sdig sgrib sbyangs/ seng ge sgra'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du brkyangs pa/ g.yon sku rgyab tu gdan la brten pa/ ral pa'i thor cog bcings shing*/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas logs su sku la cung zad ma reg pa'i tri shū la ljang gu gyen du bsgrengs pa la sbrul dkar pos dkris pa/ g.yon logs su pad+ma dkar po'i steng na ral gri me 'bar ba dang*/ me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs pas gang ba'i thod pa dkar po can/ kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ tshangs skud ma gtogs pa'i rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po// thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/

thugs ka'i nang du zla ba la hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun seng ge sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siṃ ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā sogs mtshan sngags lan gcig sbyar bas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis sngar ltar mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ de nyid kyi tshe rigs lnga'i 'od zer spro ba'ang grub ste/ gnas de nyid nas 'phros nas de nyid du bzhugs par bshad/ dbu'i steng du rnam par snang mdzad/ dpung pa g.yas par mi bskyod pa/ g.yon par 'od dpag med/ dku g.yas par rin chen 'byung ldan/ g.yon par don yod grub pa rnams bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod do// gnyis pa ni lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad la/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig gi mtha' mar sngags phreng kha dog dkar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlabs par bsams shing*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsiṃ ha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci mang dang*/ thun gsham du/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/

ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a ka ṭe/ bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭa/ ka ṭaṅka ṭe/ ka ro ṭe/ ka ro ṭa/ bī d+ye swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun du byon par bsam mo// gsum pa ni de la oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siṃ ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra zhes lan cig sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ thub pa'i dbang pos spyi gtsug brgyan// sku mdog dkar gsal gangs ri 'dra// nyon mongs ma lus pad+ma bzhin// thugs rje che zhing mgon gyur pa// nyon mongs sems can phongs gyur pa// dran pas sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa// mgon du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ rje btsun seng ge sgra'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bzhi pa ni oṃ badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o// gnyis pa bum pa la/ lha bum gyi steng du dung chos gzungs rdor dang bcas pa bshams nas/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul chings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba/ lha'i bum pa'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar aḥlas seng ge dkar po mgo bo g.yas su bstan zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa/ ral pa dmar po thur la 'phyang zhing rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyila'akhor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bcom zhing sdig sgrib sbyangs/ seng ge sgra'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ de nyid rje btsun seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du brkyangs pa/ g.yon sku rgyab tu gdan la brten pa/ ral pa'i thor cog bcings shing*/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas logs su sku la cung zad ma reg pa'i tri shū la ljang gu gyen du bsgrengs pa la sprul dkar pos dkris pa/ g.yon logs su pad+ma dkar po'i steng na ral gri me 'bar ba dang*/ me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs pas gang ba'i thod pa dkar po can/ kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ tshangs skud ma gtogs pa'i rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ naṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso bo'i mdun du chu bdag wā ru ṇa dkar po bka' nod pa'i tshul du gnas pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du mtha' yas sngon po/ lhor nor rgyas ser po/ nub tu 'jog po dmar po/ byang du stobs rgyu ljang gu/ mer pad+ma dmar po/ srin por pad+ma chen po sngon po/ rlung du dung skyong ser po/ dbang ldan du rigs ldan dkar po ste/ thams cad kyang stod mi'i rnam pa can thal mo sbyar ba/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan pa'i spyi bor yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal pos brgyan pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil pa/ de'i phyi rol du shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/

lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa be con 'dzin pa/ mer me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa me thab 'dzin pa/ bden bral du srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ rlung du rlung lha ljang gu sha ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa lha ser po phag la zhon pa bum pa 'dzin pa/ zhes pa bskyed la/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rje btsun seng ge sgra'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// sogs sh+lo ka gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siṃ ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siṃ ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā sogs nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ta ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las lha thams cad la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/

mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ dharmā ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ brtse ba'i thugs rje'i dbang phyug nyid kyi sku// drang srong chen po'i tshul du bzhugs nas kyang*// 'gro ba'i gdung ba thams cad sel mdzad pa'i// bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa// chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med kyang*// rnam 'phrul du mas bstan pa skyong*// phyogs skyong bcu la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod do// gzungs thag blangs te/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas bum nang gi lha'i rgyud bskul nas thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ seng ge sgra'i snying po brgya rtsa dang*/ gzungs ring ci nus dang*/ klu'i rgyal po dgu'i sngags ni/ oṃ phuḥwā ru ṇā ya nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ phuḥ.a nan+tā ya nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ phuḥbā su kā ya nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ phuḥtak+ṣa kā ya nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ phuḥkarko ṭā ya nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ phuḥpad+mā ya nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ phuḥm hā pad+mā ya na ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ phuḥshaṃ kha pā lā ya nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ phuḥku li kā ya nā ga rā dza phuḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu'i sngags ni/ oṃ sha kra sa ha shra ak+ṣa na ye ag+na ye/ ya mā ya/ nair ṛ t+yā ya/ wa ru ṇā ya/ wa ya we/ ku bai rā ya/ ru ṭā ya/ ur+dhaṃ brah+ma ṇā ya/ sūr+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/

tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye/ a dhi pṛ thi wī bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ nā ge bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa bzlas so// de nas dbang gi bum pa la gzungs thag spos la/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ gong ltar snying po dang gzungs ring klu brgyad phyogs skyong gi sngags rnams kyi steng du yum gnyis kyi sngags ni/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsā ni sarba ar+tha swā dha nā ya swā hā/ oṃ pra bha wa dh+ye bhu pra bha wa dh+ye bhu r+bhu wa swaḥ pra bha wa dh+ye/ sa bid tra/ pra bha wa dh+ye/ sarba nā ga duḥkho pra sha ma na ye swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsā ni sarba ar+tha sā dha nā ya swā hā/ oṃ pra bha wa dh+ye bhu pra bha wa dh+ye bhu r+bhu wa swaḥ pra bha wa dh+ye/ sa bid tra/ pra bha wa dh+ye/ sarba nā ga duḥkho pra sha ma na ye swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsā ni sarba ar+tha sā dha nā ya swā hā/ oṃ pra bha wa dh+ye bhu pra bha wa dh+ye bhur+bhu wa swaḥ pra bha wa dh+ye/ sa bid tra/ pra bha wa dh+ye/ sarba bhū mi pa ti duḥkho pra sha ma na ye swā hā/ nyer gcig bzlas so// yang gzungs thag spos la/ rtsi sman gyi bum pa bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ dī bya a mṛ te/ san+tad+ba sha mi ta/ pra tīts+tsha tha sa sa nan/ nā ma swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas pas bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ lha'i bum pa la sngar bzhin oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs nas phyogs skyong bcu la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod cing bstod nas/ dung chos kyi mchod yon bum par blugs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bum pa'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis brtan par bsam mo// gnyis pa lha'i bya ba la gnyis/

bsgrub pa dang mchod pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ mdun bskyed kyi lha bskyed pa/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya ba/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'o// dang po ni bris sku'am maṇ+ḍal la dmigs te/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ aḥlas seng ge dkar po/ mgo bo g.yas su bstan zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa/ ral pa dmar po thur la 'phyang zhing rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bcom zhing sdig sgrib sbyangs/ seng ge sgra'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ de nyid rje btsun seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du brkyangs pa/ g.yon sku rgyab tu gdan la brten pa/ ral pa'i thor cog bcings shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas logs su sku la cung zad ma reg pa'i tri shū la ljang gu gyen du bsgrengs pa la sbrul dkar pos dkris pa/ g.yon logs su pad+ma dkar po'i steng na ral gri me 'bar ba dang*/ me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs pas gang ba'i thod pa dkar po can/ kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ tshangs skud ma gtogs pa'i rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i steng du oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi shar du hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/

lhor trām̐ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ nub tu hrīḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ byang du āḥlas don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o// gnyis pa ni lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ gsum pa ni rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gi gnas nas rje btsun seng ge sgra dang*/ rigs lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing sogs nas/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siṃ ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drang*/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs sogs nas pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul ba'i bar kun rig ltar bya/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod de/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim par bsam mo// bzhi pa ni slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā sogs nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang*/

rigs lnga la rigs lngas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// gnyis pa mchod pa la lnga/ nyer spyod/ rin chen sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga/ bstod pa'i mchod pa/ gtor ma gtong ba'o// dang po ni mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang byin rlabs gong bzhin bya/ thal mo sbyar te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siṃ ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dang pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe nas shab+da'i bar 'don pa bsgyur la/ dharmā ra ṇi tas rol mo dbul lo// gnyis pa ni/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra sogs nas/ dmag dpon gyi bar mtshan sngags ma gtogs tshigs bcad sogs kun rig bzhin no// gsum pa ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs mtshan sngags ma gtogs gzhan phan mtha' yas bzhin bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'khor ba 'dzin rgyu chags bral zhing*// 'gro ba'i don la chags pa yi// pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la bzhugs// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jigs dang bag tsha mi mnga' ba// kun tu thogs med stobs brnyes pas// seng ge dkar mo'i khri la bzhugs// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs dang snying rje'i ngo bo nyid// yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pas// zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan dang ldan// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// nyon mongs pa dang shes bya yi// dri ma gnyis spangs sku mdog dkar// 'od zer dpag med phyogs bcur spro// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// dbu la ral pa'i thor tshugs can// 'od dpag med pas rab tu mdzes// tshogs gnyis ma lus rdzogs pa po// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// spyan gsum thugs rje chen po yis// khams gsum dus gsum gzigs pa po// phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab gnyis// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi rol pa rnams 'dul ba'i phyir// rgyan spangs mchod phyir thod pa 'dzin// gangs ri ltar dkar drang srong tshul// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la// mnga' brnyes rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis// sems can don bzhugs phyed krung mdzad// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// zag bcas nyes skyon ma gos pas// pad+ma las skyes pad+ma 'dzin// pad+ma'i rigs mchog pad+ma bsnams// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i gnod pa sel mdzad pa// dri med me tog gis bkang ba'i// thod pa dkar po g.yon na 'dzin// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// shes rab ral gri ye shes 'bar// ma rig mun pa thams cad 'joms// gti mug la sogs rtsad nas gcod// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// tri shū la ni g.yas na 'dzin// sna tshogs don mdzad ljang gu ste// khams gsum nyes pa rab 'joms shing*// rtse gsum 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// gdug pa thams cad rab 'dul zhing*// chu bdag dam las mi 'da'i phyir// brang 'gro dkar pos rab tu brgyan// klu rnams 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin can// dbang bskur ba ni rab stsol zhing*// sku gsum byin rlabs thugs rje can// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// spros pa'i mtha' brgyad las grol zhing*// longs spyod rdzogs sku rnam par mdzes// sprul pa'i rigs lngas dbu la brgyan// sku gsum lhun grub khyod phyag 'tshal// shin tu dang ba'i yid kyis ni// tshig gi phreng bas khyod bstod pas// bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus kun// khyed kyi go 'phang mchog thob shog

/ces pas gtso bo la bstod do// rigs lnga la/ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings// chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku// byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la// gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa// me long ye shes rdo rje'i sku// bdud 'dul chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la// rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me// mnyam nyid ye shes rdo rje'i sku// mchog sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la// 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi chu// kun rtog ye shes rdo rje'i sku// ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la// phrag dog rdo rje bskyod pa'i rlung*// bya grub ye shes rdo rje'i sku// skyabs sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la'o// zhes pas bstod do// yang bsdu na/ mchod pa rnams sngags mchod dang*/ bstod pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan ras kyis// sems can kun la gzigs mdzad pa// stobs dang mi 'jigs mnga' brnyes pa'i// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ chos sku nam mkha'i bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod do// lnga pa gtor ma gtong ba la gnyis/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gtong ba'o// dang po ni gtor ma rnams chu gtsang mas sbyangs la/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsiṃ ha nā da'i mthar/

oṃ a kā ro btags pa gsum mam lngas phul la/ mtshan sngags lan gcig sngon 'gro'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sogs sh+lo ka gcig gis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ rje btsun seng ge sgra'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i cha gsum gyi yi ge ltar bya'o// 'on kyang phyogs 'byung gnyis kyi mgor oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gsum gyis gtor ma byin gyis brlab/ bden bdar gyi mgor oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces bzla/ gsum pa klu dang 'brel pa'i cho ga la drug klu bskyed pa/ byin gyis brlab pa/ dgug gzhug bya ba/ dbang bskur ba/ mchod pa/ bstod pa bya ba'o// dang po ni/ klu'i gzugs dang dkyil 'khor bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa nang nas rim pa bzhin dmar sngo dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing*/ mda' yab dang pu shus mdzes par byas pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pas mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa/ de'i phyi rol du sgo bzhi'i thad sor shar du sbrul dkar po gnyis/ lhor sbrul ser po gnyis/ nub tu sbrul dmar po gnyis/ byang du sbrul ljang gu gnyis rnams brang sprad cing mtshams bzhir mjug ma mdud pa/ de'i phyi rol du lcags ri sngon pos bskor ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/

nang gi phyogs mdog shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du nam̐ dgu po las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su chu bdag wā ru ṇa dkar po/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi shar du mtha' yas sngon po/ lhor nor rgyas ser po/ nub tu 'jog po dmar po/ byang du stobs rgyu ljang gu/ mer pad+ma dmar po/ srin por pad+ma chen po sngon po/ rlung du dung skyongs ser po/ dbang ldan du rigs ldan dkar po ste/ thams cad kyang stod mi'i rnam pa can thal mo sbyar ba/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan pa'i spyi bor yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal pos brgyan pa/ dar dang rin po ches spras pa/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil pa'o// zhes bskyed/ gnyis pa ni/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum byin gyis brlab bo// gsum pa ni rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil nas klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la/ klu dang sa bdag dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad cing*// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// mthe bong gnyis gshibs pa'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad/ sor mo rnams brkyangs la gdengs ka'i tshul du byas pa mthe bong nang du g.yab cing*/ oṃ e h+ye hi nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ swa wi ti/ pra wi ti/ ā gats+tsha/ ā gats+tsha swā hā/ slar yang gdengs ka nor bu sogs nas ā gats+tsha swā hā'i bar tshar gnyis te khyon lan gsum gyis spyir dgug de nas/ oṃ wā ru ṇā ya e h+ye hi/

oṃ a nan+tā ya e h+ye hi/ oṃ bā su kā ya e h+ye hi/ oṃ tak+ṣa kā ya e h+ye hi/ oṃ karko ṭā ya e h+ye hi/ oṃ pad+mā ya e h+ye hi/ oṃ mahā pad+mā ya e h+ye hi/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya e h+ye hi/ oṃ ku li kā ya e h+ye hi/ zhes pas so sor spyan drang ngo*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ bzhi pa ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku lu sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā sogs nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni sogs nas/ de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pa re res dbur brgyan par bsam mo// lnga pa ni/ mchod pa rnams sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ wā ru ṇā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ a nan+tā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ bā su kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ karko ṭā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ mahā pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku li kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ wā ru ṇa ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ a nan+ta ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ bā su kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ karko ṭā ya grih+ṇe daṃ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/

oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku laṃ kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ ༈ oṃ wā ru ṇā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ oṃ a nan+ta ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ oṃ bā su kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ oṃ karko ṭā ya gṛh+ṇa daṃ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ oṃ pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ oṃ mahā pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku li kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ ༈ oṃ wā ru ṇa ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dhū paṃ swā hā/ oṃ a nan+tā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dhū paṃ swā hā/ oṃ bā su kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dhū paṃ swā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dhū paṃ swā hā/ oṃ karko ṭā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dhū paṃ swā hā/ oṃ pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dhū paṃ swā hā/ oṃ ma hā pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dhū paṃ swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dhū paṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku li kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dhū paṃ swā hā/ ༈ oṃ wā ru ṇā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dī paṃ swā hā/ oṃ a nan+tā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dī paṃ swā hā/ oṃ bā su kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dhū paṃ swā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dī paṃ swā hā/ oṃ karko ṭā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dī paṃ swā hā/ oṃ pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dī paṃ swā hā/ oṃ mahā pad+ma ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dī paṃ swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dī paṃ swā hā// oṃ ku li kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ dī paṃ swā hā/ ༈ /oṃ wā ru ṇā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ oṃ a nat+nā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ oṃ bā su kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ oṃ karko ṭā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ oṃ pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ oṃ mahā pad+ma ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/

oṃ ku li kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ ༈ oṃ wā ru ṇā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ nai wi d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ a nan+ta ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ nai wi d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ bā su kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ nai wi d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ nai wi d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ karko ṭā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ nai wi d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ nai wi d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ mahā pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ nai wi d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ nai wi d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku li kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ nai wi d+yaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa rnams nyer spyod so so'i phyag rgya dbul/ 'bras chen 'o ma dang sbyar ba dang*/ snum khur/ mngar gsum dang bcas pa gtor ma la bzhag la/ klu'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun gyi gtor ma chab kyis bran/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ wā ru ṇā ya/ a nan+tā ya/bā su kā ya/ tak+ṣa kā ya/ karko ṭā ya/ pad+mā ya/ mahā pad+mā ya/ shaṃ kha pā lā ya/ ku li kā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bo shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba nā ga le le re re ra tsi na phuḥ ṭa ṭa ra tsi te he he gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā da ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ gdugs kyi phyag rgya kun rig bzhin bcas la/ oṃ wā ru ṇā ya grih+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ ts+tsha traṃ ga swā hā/ oṃ a nan+ta ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ ts+tsha traṃ ga swā hā/ oṃ bā su kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ ts+tsha traṃ ga swā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ ts+tsha traṃ ga swā hā/ oṃ karko ṭā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ ts+tsha traṃ ga swā hā/ oṃ pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ ts+tsha traṃ ga swā hā/

oṃ ma hā pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ ts+tsha traṃ ga swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ ts+tsha traṃ ga swā hā/ oṃ ku li kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ ts+tsha traṃ ga swā hā/ ༈ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi nam mkha' la 'phan nam ba dan 'dogs pa'i tshul byas la/ oṃ wā ru ṇā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ pa tāṃ ka swā hā/ oṃ a nan+ta ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ pa tāṃ ka swā hā/ oṃ bā su kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ pa tāṃ ka swā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ pa tāṃ ka swā hā/ oṃ karko ṭā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ pa tāṃ ka swā hā/ oṃ pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ pa tāṃ ka swā hā/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ pa tāṃ ka swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ pa tāṃ ka swā hā/ oṃ ku li kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ pa tāṃ ka swā hā/ ༈ lag pa g.yas pa'i gung mdzub gshibs pa'i phyag rgyas ras skud kyi lda ldi bre ba'i tshul dang bcas/ oṃ wā ru ṇā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha nyad dz+nyo bha wi twaṃ swā hā/ oṃ a nan+ta ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ nyad dz+nyo bha wi twaṃ swā hā/ oṃ bā su kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ nyad dz+nyo bha wi twaṃ swā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ nyad dz+nyo bha wi twaṃ swā hā/ oṃ karko ṭā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ nyad dz+nyo bha wi twaṃ swā hā/ oṃ pad+mā ya grih+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ nyad dz+nyo bha wi twaṃ swā hā/ oṃ mahā pad+mā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ nyad dz+nyo bha wi twaṃ swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ nyad dz+nyo bha wi twaṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku li kā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ nyad dz+nyo bha wi twaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod/ drug pa bstod pa ni/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mtha' yas nor rgyas la sogs klu dbang rnams// chu gter rgya mtsho gting mtha' rab zab nas// rin chen sna tshogs kyis spras yid yong ba'i// pho brang 'byor pa che ldan gnas na bzhugs// dbu la sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka'i tshogs dbus na// yid bzhin nor bu bsam kun rdzogs byed cing*// bdag gzhan don 'byor phun tshogs 'byung ba'i gnas// 'od 'bar la sogs mun sel rnams kyis brgyan// tshe rabs du mar yon tan legs sbyang mthus// klu dbang 'byor pa mtha' yas yang dag rdzogs// rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs che la mnga' brnyes pa'i// yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab khyod la 'dud// dad ldan rgyal ba'i bka' thos zhal mthong zhing*// sgrub la brtson pas sangs rgyas thugs su chud// thabs dang snying rjes gzhan don rdzogs mdzad pa// bdag dang gzhan don 'byor pa khyod la 'dud// sngon tshe bde gshegs spyan sngar bka' bsgos te// bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro la phan gdags phyir// dam las ma 'da' dam tshig rjes dgongs la// gsol gdab las mdzod bdag don yongs rdzogs mdzod// klu yi rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin sogs nas kun 'grub shog ces pas bstod pa dang phrin las gzhol lo// bzhi pa gdon gyi bya ba la bzhi/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ gso ba/ dbang bskur ba/ dam la bzhag pa'o// dang po mchod pa'i yul spyan drang bar bya ste gdengs ka'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ nā ga nan/ nā ga ni nan/ nā ga ku mā ra nan/ nā ga ku mā ra ni nan/ ā gats+tsha/ ā gats+tsha/ lan gsum gyis klu phal pa rigs bzhi dang*/ yang*/ oṃ bhūmi pa ti nan/ bhū mi pa ti ni nan/ bhū mi pa ti ku mā ra nan/ bhū mi pa ti ku mā ra ni nan/ ā gats+tsha/ ā gats+tsha/ zhes lan gsum gyis sa bdag phal pa rigs bzhi dgug de nas bye brag tu sha gnyer ba dgug ste/ sems can thams cad dang*/ bye brag tu sha gnyer ba rnams la snying brtse ba'i bsam pas 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcings la/

bden pa'i stobs brjod cing dgug ste/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i bden pa dang*/ klu'i rgyal po dgu'i bden pa dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs dang*/ bdag cag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa de'i mthus/ sbyin pa'i bdag po la gnod cing sha gnyer ba'i klu dang sa bdag gi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par gyur nas/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam la mchod pa'i gnas 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ nā ma nā ga nan/ nā ga ni nan/ nā ga ku mā ra nan/ nā ga ku mā ra ni nan/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba nā ga le le re re ra tsi na phuḥ ṭa ṭa ra tsi te he he/ ā gats+tsha/ ā gats+tsha/ zhes dang*/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti nan/ bhū mi pa ti ni nan/ bhū mi pa ti ku mā ra nan/ bhū mi pa ti ku mā ra ni nan/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba bhū mi pa ti le le re re ra tsi na phuḥ ṭa ṭa ra tsi te he he/ ā gats+tsha/ ā gats+tsa zhes brjod de/ na mo rje btsun sogs nas 'di'i bar lan gsum gyis dgug des kyang ma khugs snyam pa'i the tshom yod na/ rdo rje lcags kyu mas kyang dgug par bya ste/ g.yon pa'i gung mdzub sta zur phyogs su bzhag g.yas pa'i mdzub mo gung mo'i steng du bkug la gzhag mthe bos srin lag dang mthe'u chung mnan la/ oṃ tsu ru kun+dha/ tsu ru kun+dha/ sarba nā ga ā kar+ṣa ya hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum dang*/ nā ga'i gnas su bhū mi pa ti bcug pa lan gsum gyis bkug nas/ mchod pa rnams gong ltar bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ nā ga nan/ nā ga ni nan/ nā ga ku mā ra nan/

bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang*// gsang sngags rig sngags rnams kyi mthu stobs kyis// 'gro ba 'di dag bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel ba dang*// theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung ba yi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa nyi ma dang zla ba sgra gcan las grol ba bzhin du/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad las thar zhing mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya/ zhes brjod nas slongs te khri la sogs pa'i steng du bzhag la/ nad pa la dkar gsum la sogs pa'i zas bzang po sman du bsam la drangs te/ sangs rgyas mngon par sangs rgyas tshe// 'jig rten skyong bzhis phyogs bzhi nas// snod bzhi dag ni blangs nas kyang*// bde bar gshegs la phul ba dang*// mthu yis gcig tu sprul mdzad nas// lha yi snod mchog de dag tu// bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman rnams ni// ston pa'i phyag na bsnams pa yi// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// sa bdag klu gnyan nad sel zhing*// nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa'i// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /de bzhin lha mo 'phrog ma yis// lha rdzas dge ba a ru ra// blangs nas ston la rab phul ba// bdag nyid 'dra ba'i sman rnams ni// ston pa'i phyag na bsnams pa yi// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// sa bdag klu gnyan nad sel zhing*// nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa'i// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang*// gtsug gtor can gyi stobs mchog dang*// thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang*// log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang*// gser thub ces bya'i ye shes dang*// 'od srung gi ni rdzu 'phrul dang*// shākya seng ge'i mthu stobs dang*// seng ge sgra yi smon lam gyis// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// sa bdag klu gnyan nad sel zhing*// nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa'i// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog

/sad+yā the dan/ kha re kha re/ wa kha re/ tsa le bi tsa le bi laṃ bhi ma le/ sa ma pa ri tsaṇ+ṭe tsaṇ+ṭe ṇi a mṛ te/ nir+gho she swā hā/ de nas oṃ āḥhrīḥsiṃ ha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdor dril 'dzin pas me tog gtor zhing*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs nas ldan par shog /nyin mo bde legs sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ zas la longs spyad pa'i lhag ma sa bdag gi gzugs 'gros kyi steng du gzhag go /ces pa 'di phyag len ltar bris pa yin cing*/ mdzad mi spro na sngar bshad pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad nas/ zas sman du bsgyur ba'i bar rnams ma brjod kyang nyes pa med cing*/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa bud+dha'i mtshan can de ltar mdzad do// yang nad pa sogs med na/ bkru byabs srung gsum sogs bya mi dgos pas rjes kyi cho ga sogs byas pas chog go /gsum pa rjes la lnga/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa/ bzod par gsol ba/ gshegs su gsol ba/ bdag nyid bsrung ba/ dge ba bsngo ba sogs so// dang po ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos la bsang sbyang*/ byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siṃ ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ brtse ba'i thugs rje'i dbang phyug nyid kyi sku// drang srong chen po'i tshul du bzhugs nas kyang*// 'gro ba'i gdung ba thams cad sel mdzad pa'i// bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa// chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med kyang*// rnam 'phrul du mas bstan pa skyong*// phyogs skyong bcu la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod do// bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ rje btsun seng ge sgra'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gsum pa ni/ gdengs ka'i phyag rgya bkrol la/ oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gis// lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i// nad de nye bar phyung nas su// klu rnams rang gi gnas su dengs// de ltar bdag gis ces dus kyis// mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yi// dam tshig gnas la gnas gyis la// bdag gi bsam pa skong bar mdzod// rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing*// 'dir ni sbyin pa'i bdag po yi// nad de rab tu phyung mdzod la// klu rnams rang gi gnas su song*// 'jig rten na mchod dus gtso bo nas mchod/ gshegs dus phal pa nas gshegs par bya ste/ nā ga nan/ nā ga ni nan/ nā ga ku mā ra nan/ nā ga ku mā ra ni nan/ a hi gats+tsha/ zhes pas klu phal pa rigs bzhi dang*/ yang*/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti nan/ bhū mi pa ti ni nan/ bhū mi pa ti ku mā ra nan/ bhū mi pa ti ku mā ra ni nan/ a hi gats+tsha/ zhes pas sa bdag phal pa rigs bzhi dang*/ oṃ wā ru ṇā ya/ a nan+tā ya/ bā su kā ya/ tak+ṣa kā ya/ karko ṭā ya/ pad+mā ya/ ma hā pad+mā ya/ shaṃ kha pā lā ya/ ku li kā ya/ a hi gats+tsha/ klu chen dgu gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ yang*/ oṃ sha kra sa ha shra ak+ṣa na ye/ ag+na ye/ ya mā ya/ nair ṛ t+yā ya/ wā ru ṇā ya/ wa ya we/ ku bai rā ya/ ru ṭā ya/ ur+dhaṃ brah+ma ṇā ya/ sūr+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye/ a dhi pṛ thi wī bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ nā ge bh+yaḥswā hā/ a hi gats+tsha/ zhes pas mtheb srin gyis se gol dang bcas pas gshegs su gsol/ rgyas par na/ nā ga nan/ a hi gats+tsha/ nā ga ni nan/ a hi gats+tsha/ zhes pa sngags so so'i mthar btags pas gshegs su gsol bar bya/

oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad nas gsol zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam mo// rdul tshon rnams rang rang gi gzugs 'gros kyi steng du blug lha'i rdul tshon klu'i gzugs 'gros kyi steng du bzhag pa rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len las shes par bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ nad pa'i gdon rang la 'pho srid pas/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyi byin gyis brlab cing*/ bsrung ba'i bye brag gzhan yang bya'o// lnga pa dge ba bsngo ba sogs ni/ dge ba 'di yis sogs spyi ltar dang*/ slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba'i bum pa'i chu sbrengs shing de'i rjes su klu phal pa'i gzugs 'gros gtor ma dang*/ klu'i gzugs dang gtor ma dang*/ phyogs skyong dang 'byung po'i gtor ma dang*/ lha'i gtor ma dang rdul tshon rnams klu gnas pa'i mtsho'am/ chu mig gam/ 'bab chu la sogs pa'i nang du rol mo dang bcas pas bskyal lo// de nas chu khyer te thig rjes rnams dbyi'o// tshar grangs lta bu dgos na tshar re bzhin gzugs 'gros bzos nas gshegs pa ma gtogs zhag sogs bzhag mi rung ste/ mgron phal pa rnams la brtan bzhugs mi 'os pa'i phyir ro// slob dpon 'khor bcas kyis shis pa brjod pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod cing*/ 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i ngang nas dge ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo zhing*/ rjes kyi bya ba mi mngon par byas la/ dga' ston la longs spyod cing slob dpon 'khor bcas yon gyis mnyes par bya'o// rje btsun 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i// gdon sgrol cho ga rin chen phreng mdzes 'di// dkar dang dmar dang rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs// rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung dang mthun par bkod// 'di la 'gal dang ma 'brel zlos pa sogs// nongs pa gang mchis bdag cag rmongs pa'i skyon// yin phyir bla ma lhar bcas spyan sngar bshags// sngon bsags sdig dang lhan cig sbyang du gsol// 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge tshogs bdud rtsi'i char// rje btsun thugs rje'i sprin las babs pa des// gdon gyis zin pas las sgrib kun sbyangs nas// rgyal ba'i ye shes rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig

/'jig rten dbang phyug go 'phang thob phyir du// ha cang rgyas dang ha cang bsdus min par// dang po'i las can don du bklag chog sbyar// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur thob shog /ces rje btsun 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i gdon sgrol gyi cho ga rin chen phreng mdzes zhes bya ba/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa 'di nyid 'phags pa rin po che'i phyag rgyun dang mthun par snang bas shin tu khungs btsun pa'i phyir/ 'jam dbyangs sangs phun pas mchan 'ga' rer mdzad 'dug pa'i steng du slar yang lag len gyi gsal kha dang*/ ngag 'don sogs khong rnams bsab ste/ e waṃ pa'i phyag bzhes rnam dag gi tshul du rgyal khams pa ngag dbang blo gros snying po gzhan phan mtha' yas pa'i 'od zer zhes bod pas sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos gar bsdebs pa'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /seng ge sgra'i brgyud 'debs ni/ seng ge sgra dang tsan+d+ra go mī'i zhabs// bram ze dpal 'dzin nā ro ta pa dang*// pham 'thing sku mched as+thu la badz+ra// thugs rje chen po mal lo blo gros grags// sa chen gtsug tor rgyal po rje btsun pa// sa skya paṇa chen shar pa sher 'byung dang*// dus 'khor pa dang kun dga' byang chub dang*// rgyal bzang grags dpal ma ti paṇa chen zhabs// sa bzang 'phags pa khyab bdag kun dga' bzang*// rgyal tshab kun dbang 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel// lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub dang*// nam mkha' dpal bzang dpal ldan don grub zhabs// shes rab 'byung gnas mkhas btsun kun dga' legs// dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs dang bcom ldan 'das// seng ge sgra sogs yi dam lha yi tshogs// phyag byar 'os pa kun la gsol 'debs kyis// gnas skabs sa bdag klu gnyan nyer 'tshe sogs// dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun spangs nas// bsam don chos dang mthun par legs grub ste// mthar thug bla med byang chub myur thob shog

/ces pa 'di'ang a wa dhū ti pa bud+dha lak+ṣīs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ gong du rtsi sman gyi bum pa'i rdzas kyi ngos 'dzin ni/ spyir rje btsun grags pa'i dngos slob dkar shākya grags kyi gdon sgrol gyi cho gar/ klu'i bum par nā ga puṣ+pa dang*/ nā ga ge sar dang*/ pad+ma dkar po dang*/ ut+pal sngon po dang*/ u shi ra'am pu shel rtse dang*/ ra dkar mo'i 'o ma'am ba ser skya'i 'o ma dang*/ dri zhim po'i chus dgang*/ shing lo rlon pas kha brgyan par bya'o// zhes dang*/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po'i yig char yang de dang mtshungs par gsungs pas gzhung nas bshad pa'i sman thams cad ma 'byor kyang*/ gang 'byor tsam khungs dag cing ngos 'dzin ma 'khrul pa gal che bar snang*/ de la skabs don rang lugs kyi yig cha 'di'i dngos bstan ltar na/ ston dus su brkos pa'i spang spos rtsa lo yongs rdzogs dri ngad ma yal ba la gzhi byas/ de steng dzā ti/ cu gang*/ gur gum/ li shi/ sug smel/ ka ko la ste bzang po drug ka ra bal yul sogs nas 'byung ba'i phag tshil gyis ma bzhus pa/ bu ram mar dkar gyis bzhus pa dang*/ sbrang srog chags kyi ro sogs dang bral ba'i gtsang ma/ a ru/ ba ru/ skyu ru ra ste 'bras bu gsum/ rgya mtsho lbu ba dngos ni phyi'i rgya mtsho'i rlabs brag la phog pa'i rgyu las byung ba dbyibs gnyer ma can mdog nag ngam zhig yod kyang 'byor dka'/ da lta yongs grags dkar sob 'di 'bu khog tu snang bas mi btang*/ tshab rung tsam du chu mig gi phugs su chags pa'i chu bal ljang gu srog chags sogs kyi ro dang ma 'dres pa btang ba'i phyag len snang*/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri yongs grags 'di'i phyi'i kog pa dang nang gi rkang phral/ chu srin sder mo sman gyi skabs nā gi la 'jug pa shas che na'ang*/ skabs 'dir brag la skyes pa'i sngo sman gyi gras de btang*/ dbang lag sor mo lnga pa nas gsum pa yan gang 'byor/ pad+ma ge sar dang nā ga ge sar deng sang sman pa rnams kyis ge sar gsum ldan du byed pa 'di btang ba shas che yang dngos ni so sor yod par gsungs/

ma 'byor na nā ga ge sar dang*/ nā ga puṣ+pa gnyis ka'i tshab tu skabs 'dir 'om bu'i me tog lo 'bras bcas dang*/ pad+ma ge sar gyi tshab ut+pal btang bar 'ga' zhig gis mdzad snang*/ snyi ba'i me tog ni glo sman gyi sde tshan du bshad pa'i sman pa rnams la yongs grags sngo snyi ba'i me tog dang*/ dpe la lar gra ma'i me tog ces snang ba ltar na klu shing gra ma'i me tog ste 'di gnyis gang btang rung 'gal ba med/ ut+pal sngon po dngos rgya bal nas 'byung ba dang*/ tshab rung bod du skyes pa gang rnyed/ mtshal dkar ni shag mtshal sogs rdo mtshal te/ de la'ang nang gses su dkar nag gnyis las/ smug shas che ba nag po dang*/ dmar skya shas che ba dkar por bzhed pas phyi ma 'byor na legs/ pu shel rtse dang rtsa 'ba' la don gcig pa spos sman du 'gro ba de ka dang*/ zho sha rnams ni sman pa rnams la yongs su grags pas ngos 'dzin dang 'byor sla/ rma bya'i mdongs ni bal yul sogs nas khyer 'ong ba'i rtsa rma bya'i gtsug phud du grags pa nyid yin/ ma 'byor na 'ga' zhig gis sman pa rnams la grags pa'i rtsa khu byug gam/ ko ṭha'i me tog btang zhes zer/ phyag tshang ku ba ni shing tog ku ba/ nor bu myu gu zhes pa mchan rnying pa rnams las 'phel gdung zhes snang ba/ rnam par dpyad na nor bu ni 'byor na 'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel dang*/ ma rnyed na mu tig sogs rin po che'i rigs btang yang rung*/ myu gu zhes pas skabs 'dir rtswa ku sha yin par rtog go /le brgan dmar po ni dar dmar po dngos btang ba dang*/ bal po gur gum btang ba'ang snang zhing phyi ma 'thad par bzhed/ lhang ma lhang tsher dkar nag gnyis las 'dir dkar po/ mkhal srun gre'u zhes sran ma ṣā 'am/ sran dkar/ dpe la lar mkhal sran khre zhes snang ba ltar na/ phyi ma 'bru'i rigs yongs grags/ gser gyi me tog sngo pri yaṅku/ spang rgyan dkar po dang sngon po bcas yongs grags dang*/

shu dag dkar po dbyibs shu dag nag po 'dra ba la/ mdog dkar zhing tshigs thag ri ba/ dri chung ba de btang*/ sle tres shun pa phral/ gro ma dang*/ mon bu dkar po'i rtsa ba dang*/ rgun 'brum dkar po bcas so// de lta bu'i sman rnams kyang dmar skyur dang gla rtsi sogs kyi dris ma phog pa shin tu gal che/ lag len dus su'ang rnam 'joms sam sme brtsegs kyi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i khrus chus dag par bkrus la grib mar bskam/ de nas rtsi bzhin tu btags la cha gnyis su bya/ cha gcig ra dkar po dang*/ ba ser skya'i 'o ma/ gong du smos pa'i mngar gsum bcas sbyar la bum pa gtsang mar blugs/ de dang mnyam du dbang bum yang bsham/ de nas seng ge sgra'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas thog mar dbang bum gyi bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas rtsi sman gyi bum pa bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i sngags nyid khri sogs gtso bor bzlas la byin gyis brlab/ dbang bum gyi bum chu dang rtsi sman gyi bum rdzas bcas sman phye cha gcig dang sbyar ba ril bur dril la grib mar bskam/ legs par bskams pa dang rlung mi 'chor ba'i snod gtsang mar klu sman gyi phye ma cung zad dang lhan cig tu tshags bya/ dgos dus su 'o ma dang dri bzang gi chu la sbyar te rtsi sman gyi bum par blug go /zhes klu sman gyi ngos 'dzin 'di ni kun gzigs mkhyen brtse rin po ches gnang ba'o// ༈ /rjes chog skabs phyogs skyong yod pa ni dkar shākya grags dang*/ 'phags pa'i dngos slob rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis bum bzlas skabs su gtso bo 'od zhu zur tsam las/ 'khor rnams gshegs zhu gang yang ma bshad pas rjes su gshegs rgyu yin nam/ de gnyis kas gtor mgron phyogs skyong ma gtogs cha gsum ma bshad pas gtor mgron gshegs pa gang yin da rung zin bris gzhan rnyed na brtag dgos so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/
